files.README.md:
# Rookwood Mushroom Farm - growing rooms

Shared folder for the cropping team.

- rooms/  cards for each growing room
- spawn/  delivery notes from the supplier

turns.prompt: A grower at Rookwood Mushroom Farm asked what six air changes an hour means for a crop room; the whole volume of the room is replaced that many times every hour. Room C-12 holds 840 cubic metres of air and runs at 6 air changes an hour. Give the air moved through the room each minute, as a single number in cubic metres with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
